item.title: Closed Network Operation and the Network Separation Transition
item.description:
Where this page fits

This guide covers the use and management of open source in the financial sector. Its starting point is the closed network. Import, internal mirrors, and offline vulnerability management are prerequisites for every stage, including identification, use approval, and management, so they are explained once here, and each stage page points to this page with an “Applying in a closed network” box.

Documents produced here: an import procedure and import approval records, and a self risk assessment for a network separation exception.

item.title: Policy and Procedure Templates
item.description:
The forms here are outlines that add items specific to the financial sector. For general open source policy and process forms, use the existing policy and procedure templates guide, and use the forms below for what the financial sector additionally needs: import control, risk assessment for network separation exceptions, and SBOM requirements for outsourcing.

How to use

The outlines below are not finished documents to use as they are, but frames to fill in. Replace the parts in square brackets to suit your organization. Have them reviewed by your internal legal and security teams before issuing them.

item.title: Practical Guide to Open Source Management in the Financial Sector
item.description:
Financial institutions use more and more open source, yet they must manage it under conditions specific to their sector: closed networks, network separation regulations, supply chain security, and audit response. This guide connects the management procedures set out in the “Guide to Using and Managing Open Source Software in the Financial Sector” (금융분야 오픈소스 소프트웨어 활용·관리 안내서; Financial Supervisory Service (금융감독원) and Financial Security Institute (금융보안원), 2022) with the verification materials of the international standards ISO/IEC 5230 and 18974 and with the existing KWG practical guides. It shows practitioners, in an actionable form, what they need to put in place and in what order.
